parsed.rationale: Both `ArtistRepository` and `ReleaseRepository` in the `Metadata` package share three identical members — `cacheKey:(for id: Int) -> String`, `entityKind:String`, and `lastSync:Date?` — differing only in the return type of their `resolve` method (`Artist` vs `Release`). Extracting those three shared members into a common parent protocol `MetadataRepository` eliminates the duplication and makes the caching/sync contract explicit at the protocol level. The `resolve` method can either remain in each child protocol with its concrete return type, or be expressed as an associated-type requirement if a PAT approach is preferred. Both files live in the same package (`Metadata`) and neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code, so there is no boundary reason to keep them separate.
